mapper.sql: select log_id, module, feature, user_id, user_name, status, duration_ms, prompt_digest, error_msg, call_time, create_time from ai_call_log
mapper.insert: insert into ai_call_log (module, feature, user_id, user_name, status, duration_ms, prompt_digest, error_msg, call_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{module}, #{feature}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{status}, #{durationMs}, #{promptDigest}, #{errorMsg}, #{callTime}, #{userName}, sysdate())
mapper.select:
and module = #{module} and feature like concat('%', #{feature}, '%') and user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and status = #{status}
and date_format(call_time,'%y%m%d') >= date_format(#{params.beginTime},'%y%m%d')
and date_format(call_time,'%y%m%d') <= date_format(#{params.endTime},'%y%m%d')
order by log_id desc

select module, count(*) as total, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as success, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as degraded, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as failed, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as limited from ai_call_log where call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by module order by total desc

select module, feature, count(*) as total, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as success, round(avg(duration_ms)) as avgDuration from ai_call_log where call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by module, feature order by total desc limit 20

select count(*) as total, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as success, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as degraded, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as failed, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as limited, round(avg(duration_ms)) as avgDuration from ai_call_log where call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
select status, count(*) as cnt from ai_call_log group by status

select date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as total, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as success, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as failed, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as limited, round(avg(duration_ms)) as avgDuration from ai_call_log where call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select user_name, count(*) as total, sum(case when status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as success, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as failed, count(distinct date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) as activeDays, round(avg(duration_ms)) as avgDuration from ai_call_log where call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) and user_name is not null and user_name != '' and user_name != 'null' group by user_name order by total desc limit 15

select hour(call_time) as hour, count(*) as total, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as failed from ai_call_log where call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by hour(call_time) order by hour
select status, count(*) as total from ai_call_log where call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by status

select module, date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as total from ai_call_log where call_time >= date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day) group by module, date_format(call_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date
